description: Ceylinco Homes International (Lotus Tower) Limited v. Commissioner General of Labour and Others Ceylinco Homes International (Lotus Tower) Limited v. Commissioner General of Labour and Others View More before Hon. H.N.J. Perera, J.
parties: Ceylinco Homes International (Lotus Tower) Limited v. Commissioner General of Labour and Others Ceylinco Homes International (Lotus Tower) Limited v. Commissioner General of Labour and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought to quash the 1st Respondent’s order directing payment of compensation to three employees whose services had been terminated due to vis major or supervening impossibility. Held - terminations were effected without the required approval under the Termination of Employment of Workmen (Special Provisions) Act; the 1st Respondent had jurisdiction to award compensation. Application dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Termination of Employment of Workmen (Special Provisions) Act
